summary.en: Conan is unable to figure out how a piece of rope disappeared, but when he figures out who is wearing something VERY special in his/her person, he realizes that the person has killed two people on the same night. Using Ran to reveal the secret by using his own voice, Shinichi reveals the information to everyone present, but the revelation will shock everyone involved, especially Ran and Sonoko. Both Nakamura and Yonehara hear a voice coming from a cellphone from Shimoda's room and went to ask him to shut it off. They discover that he's been murdered. As Conan has been sitting at the stairway for entire night, he thinks that one of the three teachers on the second floor must be the murderer ans still has the weapon with his/herself. However, after a body search, the weapon is not found. With Agasa's help, and right before making the big revelation, Conan is able to get very important information about a certain "Minako" person. Three years ago, a twelve-year-old girl named Minako was found hanged in the Volleyball Club Room. Back then, it was speculated that she commited suicide out of stress from either important exams or being in her last year of elementary school.

solvedByRaw: Ran Mouri (via Conan as Shinichi Kudo on phone)
